answer_2.quote: We used Exact Match Accuracy as the evaluation metric, which checks whether the predicted answers are equal to the ground truth... We also report Robustness Accuracy as the ratio of correct predictions on both pre‑ and post‑perturbation data versus pre‑perturbation data.

answer_4.quote: Two evaluators were then asked to rate each sample on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best) and determine which example was better, between the one created by human annotators and the framework.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each adversarial example on a 1‑5 Likert scale and select the better example between LETA‑generated and human‑annotated.
